name: should build a league extended salary query with explicit lid and year params
description: Explicit column params arrive normalized to arrays, so the extended salary emitter must unwrap lid and year before using either in a scalar position. Pinned to 2020 rather than the current season so the fixture does not move with the clock.
expected_query:
select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "t0077986e8e582ecfe874c7e2cdee789f"."extended_salary" AS "extended_salary_0", "player"."primary_position" from "player" left join (select "rp"."pid", CASE
          WHEN rp.slot IN (12,15,16,17) THEN COALESCE(s.salary_paid, 0)
          WHEN rp.tag = 2 THEN
            CASE rp.player_position
              WHEN 'QB' THEN COALESCE(ssn.franchise_tag_salary_quarterback, 0)
              WHEN 'RB' THEN COALESCE(ssn.franchise_tag_salary_running_back, 0)
              WHEN 'WR' THEN COALESCE(ssn.franchise_tag_salary_wide_receiver, 0)
              WHEN 'TE' THEN COALESCE(ssn.franchise_tag_salary_tight_end, 0)
              ELSE 0
            END
          WHEN rp.tag = 3 THEN COALESCE(s.salary_paid, 0)
          ELSE COALESCE(s.salary_paid, 0) + (COALESCE(rp.extensions, 0) + 1) * 5
        END AS extended_salary from "rosters_players" as "rp" left join "roster_asset_holding" as "s" on "s"."player_id" = "rp"."pid" and "s"."lid" = "rp"."lid" and "s"."tid" = "rp"."tid" and "s"."asset_type" = 1 and "s"."period_end" is null left join "seasons" as "ssn" on "ssn"."lid" = "rp"."lid" and "ssn"."season_year" = "rp"."season_year" where "rp"."lid" = 1 and "rp"."season_year" = 2020 and "rp"."week" = 0) as "t0077986e8e582ecfe874c7e2cdee789f" on "t0077986e8e582ecfe874c7e2cdee789f"."pid" = "player"."pid" group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "t0077986e8e582ecfe874c7e2cdee789f"."extended_salary", "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by 4 DESC NULLS LAST, "player"."pid" asc limit 500
